label: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result

configuration.host: Local file-openable HTML/CSS/JavaScript; no server or cloud resource.
configuration.testRuntime: Node.js v22.23.4 built-in node:test and node:assert/strict.
configuration.fixture: old-journey active blue cart; old-pinned idle unresolved blue client; old-work one pending blue effect.
configuration.readiness: Only the warm, compatible schema-1 fixture enables green new admission.
configuration.newSessionBoundary: Explicit switch; existing bindings are not moved.
configuration.nominalWeight: Advisory only. Counters derive from recorded modeled requests, not percentages.
configuration.retention: Ten manually advanced synthetic minutes after cutover, independent of drain.

order: loadable stub and genuine behavioral red

red.failureKind: Executed behavior assertion failures, not missing tooling/imports.
red.normalization: Readable red.txt trims only diagnostic trailing whitespace after the publisher rejected it before commit. Byte-exact original output and digests are retained in red-run.json and the gzip archive.

refinementRed.observation: Invalid fixture rebinding was not rejected; fixed by binding/cohort validation.
Invalid closure and missing finish-state transition were not rejected; fixed with lifecycle and before/after validation.

browser.limit: Actual visible owned file-page UI checks, not native Azure evidence. The earlier prepared page is inspection only; no hidden-tab actionability or Node mock is counted.

artifactValidation.scope: Artifact identities, relative paths, source hashes and recorded results only; not a new browser run.

postFormatRegression.scope: The existing asset/evidence subset after whitespace-only report formatting; not ten additional unique behavioral tests.

verifierResult.node: PASS: all 68 focused assertions; expected guarded rejections and the unsafe FAIL verdict are explicitly checked.
verifierResult.browser: PASS: actual visible owned forceNew file-page keyboard, safe mixed cohorts/drain/retention, unsafe interruption/loss, invalid-data/Reset, and session-boundary rollback/final Reset.

userImpact.positive: Node and real-browser-observed synthetic old completion preserves subject/cart and records one receipt; pinned reconnect preserves state and work records one effect. Final safe browser observations: six requests, blue=2, green=4, with no modeled interruption/lost work.
userImpact.unsafe: Node and real-browser-observed premature retirement interrupts both known old clients and loses one pending work item; the later pinned request is unavailable with no valid completion evidence. Browser safety verdict is explicitly FAIL.
userImpact.interpretation: A negative assertion passing is not successful migration. Nominal weights and zero active counters cannot erase unresolved pins, lost work, or required rollback retention.

cleanup.browserReset: Observed actual keyboard Reset and final Reset: zero requests/events, two baseline sessions, pending work with zero effects, ready status, default controls.
cleanup.repositoryArtifacts: Only this lesson and its namespaced tests/evidence are intended for publication.

publication.mechanism: Serialized scoped main commit, required coauthor trailer, annotated tag, atomic main/tag push and remote verification by the parent-provided publisher.
publication.implementationCommit: The commit carrying this file. Its literal SHA and verified tag are recorded after publication in the per-card orchestrator publication/result records; no self-referential SHA is invented here.

limits: This bundle is only local, synthetic training, never live Azure/native evidence.
All readiness, session, cart, state, pin, request, work, timer, and routing facts are bounded fixtures.
Real cookie/store compatibility, authentication, health probes, client discovery, native affinity, network behavior, ownership, retention policy, and real-user continuity remain unverified.
Only known fixture clients/work are considered. Real unresolved or unknown clients/work require explicit native discovery and retirement policy.
Rollback changes NEW admission only, not admitted green work or data, and is offered only inside the declared synthetic retention window.
Recorded modeled requests are not HTTP requests or Azure logs. Node assertions are not browser evidence.
Raw Node failure outputs retain their original local absolute stack paths; all bundle artifact references are relative.
No package/framework decision, infrastructure, deployment, expenditure, native B-S007 proof, completed D-S007 parent, worker acceptance, or Kano credit.
